title: A draft sent from Gmail doesn't carry the X-OpenHuman-Origin header (real Gmail)
steps: With a real Gmail account, let an agent create a draft reply to yourself so it shows in Gmail's Drafts
Open that draft in Gmail on the web or in the Gmail phone app and send it from there
In Gmail on the web open the sent message, choose Show original and search the headers for X-OpenHuman-Origin
expected: The sent message has no X-OpenHuman-Origin header. If it is there, note which client sent it (web or phone) and keep only the header lines, not the message text.
